description: The reply thread of a message (what In-Reply-To/References join to it), oldest first; root_message_id is its first message. grouping=subject: the whole subject thread, as the /m/ page shows it (may hold several reply threads). Each message: from, to, cc, date, message_id, body (own words; full_text=true for all), attachments, has_patch. Pages of 20 (limit max 500; next_offset, has_more); bodies cut at max_body_chars. include_body=false: outline.

include_llm.description: Default false: each message's llm_estimate (see llm_estimate)

name: get_thread
